lessons: Aggregate high-frequency planning ticks without consuming complete write-request rows; a tested finite capacity can still be inappropriate if unrelated periodic calls share it.
Record actual nested planning method scope, reset it after original exceptions, and keep UNSCOPED explicit. A wrapper installation context does not prove the original caller role.
Cold diagnostic initialization must precede all original writer captures. Freeze metrics while preserving live identity; retire after the original owner shutdown.
Validate exact changed-file sets without assuming manifest iteration order; preserve failed build checks and independently reread existing payload and ZIP rather than replaying successful mutations.
